answered.sql: SELECT dl.level_name AS qualification, COUNT(jp.id) AS number_of_jobs FROM Degree_Level dl JOIN Job_Post jp ON dl.id = jp.degree_level_id GROUP BY dl.level_name UNION SELECT c.cert_name AS qualification, COUNT(jp.id) AS number_of_jobs FROM Certification c JOIN Job_Post jp ON c.id = jp.certification_id GROUP BY c.cert_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of qualifications (certifications) and the number of available jobs for each
candidates.sql: SELECT cert_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_jobs FROM Job_Post JOIN Certification ON Job_Post.certification_id = Certification.id GROUP BY cert_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of job titles and the count of applications for each job title.
candidates.sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS number_of_jobs FROM Job_Post JOIN Application ON Job_Post.id = Application.job_post_id GROUP BY title

candidates.meaning: Display a list of certifications and the count of applications for each certification.
candidates.sql: SELECT cert_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_jobs FROM Job_Post JOIN Application ON Job_Post.id = Application.job_post_id JOIN Certification ON Job_Post.certification_id = Certification.id GROUP BY cert_name

candidates.meaning: Display a list of degree levels and the count of applications for each degree level.
candidates.sql: SELECT level_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_jobs FROM Job_Post JOIN Application ON Job_Post.id = Application.job_post_id JOIN Degree_Level ON Job_Post.degree_level_id = Degree_Level.id GROUP BY level_name
